title.narrative: GAIN- SEAFOOD-Sustainable Economic Advancement through Fish Opportunities for Optimal Development Project

description.narrative: SEAFOOD project aims to transform "aqua-food systems" in northern and central Mozambique to improve sustainability and inclusivity in fish value chains trough a blue economy approach. Targeting IDPs and host community members in conflict affected areas of Northern Mozambique. GAIN will also prioritise women-led businesses/SMEs in their provision of technical and financial assistance by introducing gender-sensitive grant schemes and alleviate some barriers to women access to finance (through support in formalisation of their businesses, trainings, and technical assistance), and thus ensure a more gender-inclusive financing opportunities. Implementation will be driven by a gender strategy with focus in supporting the inclusion of women and young people.
